plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.<b>Confirmation</b> : la valeur doit res: Confirmation: the value must stay beyond the threshold for this whole time before the alert. This is what keeps an open fridge door from triggering anything.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.<b>Hausse rapide</b> : la variation sur: Rapid rise: the change over the window, measured from the lowest point. For a fire, combine it with a threshold rule on the same sensor.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.<b>Hystérésis</b> : l'alerte ne s'arrête: Hysteresis: the alert only ends once the value has come back this far past the threshold. A fridge alerting at 7 °C with 1 °C of hysteresis only returns to normal at 6 °C.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.<b>Muet après</b> : un capteur sans nouv: Silent after: a sensor with no new value for this long goes to warning. Jeedom keeps the last value of a sensor with a dead battery: without this check, it would say “all is well” forever. Many sensors only publish on change: do not go too low.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Aucune surveillance pour le moment. Pour: No watch yet. To get started:
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Avertissement si le capteur ne publie pl: Warning if the sensor has published nothing for this long. 0: no check.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Chaque règle surveille un capteur. Le ni: Each rule watches one sensor. The level of the watch is the worst of its rules.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Cliquez sur « Ajouter une surveillance »: Click “Add a watch” and name it, for example “Kitchen fridge”.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Décocher pour suspendre cette règle sans: Uncheck to suspend this rule without deleting it
The change is measured over this time.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Les 50 derniers événements : alertes, ra: The last 50 events: alerts, reminders, returns to normal, acknowledgements and suspensions.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Les actions se choisissent comme dans un: Actions are chosen as in a scenario: a command (notification, siren, lamp) or a block (message, scenario, variable). In titles and messages, these words are replaced:
Number of reminders for one alert. Rising to critical restarts the count. 0: no limit.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Onglet « Actions » : ce qui doit se pass: “Actions” tab: what should happen on warning, on critical and on return to normal — a notification, a siren, a lamp, a scenario.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Onglet « Règles » : choisissez un profil: “Rules” tab: choose a profile (Fridge, Fire, Water leak…) then the sensor to watch. The suggested thresholds are fine to start with.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Plusieurs valeurs possibles, séparées pa: Several values allowed, separated by |: 1|on. Case-insensitive.
Several values allowed, separated by |: open|opened. Case-insensitive.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Quand elle passe en critique, depuis nor: When it goes critical, from normal or from warning. Left empty, the warning actions are run.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Quand la surveillance passe de normal à: When the watch goes from normal to warning.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Quand tout est revenu à la normale. #dur: When everything is back to normal. #duree# then gives the alert duration, #acquitte_par# who acknowledged it.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Sauvegardez, puis testez les actions dep: Save, then test the actions from their tab.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Suspendre coupe la surveillance le temps: Suspend stops the watch while you clean a fridge or defrost a freezer; it resumes by itself. Disable stops it until further notice. In both cases, an ongoing alert is dropped without running the return-to-normal actions.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Tant que l'alerte dure et que personne n: As long as the alert lasts and nobody has acknowledged it, the actions of its level are run again at this interval. 0: never remind.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Temps pendant lequel la valeur doit rest: Time the value must stay beyond the threshold before the alert. 0: immediate.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Un rappel rejoue les actions du niveau e: A reminder runs the actions of the current level again. Save before testing: the test runs the saved actions.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Une trace dans Jeedom même si aucune act: A record in Jeedom even if no action is set, or if the notification did not go out.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/php/alertebe.ph.Écart à regagner sous le seuil avant le: Margin to regain past the threshold before returning to normal.

plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Alerte quand la valeur a baissé d\\'au m: Alert when the value has dropped by at least this amount over the window, from its highest point.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Alerte quand la valeur a monté d\\'au mo: Alert when the value has risen by at least this amount over the window, from its lowest point. The rule goes quiet when the rise stops: pair it with a threshold rule.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Alerte quand la valeur atteint ou dépass: Alert when the value reaches or exceeds the threshold. Leave a level empty to not use it.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Alerte quand la valeur descend au seuil: Alert when the value falls to the threshold or below: frost protection, freezer off, low battery.
Alert when the value leaves the range. An empty bound is not checked.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Alerte quand le capteur vaut exactement: Alert when the sensor equals exactly this value: 1 for a leak or smoke detector, “open” for a contact. Separate several values with |: open|opened. Case-insensitive.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Aucune action critique n\\'est réglée :: No critical action is set: the warning ones are used.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Aucune action enregistrée pour ce niveau: No action saved for this level.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Aucune règle : ajoutez-en une dans l\\'o: No rule: add one in the “Rules” tab.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Ce bloc n\\'est pas utilisable ici : il: This block cannot be used here: it would hold up the Jeedom cron or only makes sense in a scenario. Use the “Scenario” action instead.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Ce bloc n\\'est utilisable que dans un s: This block can only be used in a scenario.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Décocher pour désactiver cette action sa: Uncheck to disable this action without deleting it
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Désactiver la surveillance jusqu\\'à ce: Disable the watch until someone enables it again? An ongoing alert will be dropped. For a temporary pause, prefer “Suspend”.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Exécuter en parallèle des autres actions: Run in parallel with the other actions
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Options indisponibles : la commande visé: Options unavailable: the target command may have been deleted. The saved message is kept.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Sauvegardez d\\'abord : le test joue les: Save first: the test runs the saved actions.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.Sauvegardez la surveillance pour la voir: Save the watch to see it working.
plugins/alertebe/desktop/js/alertebe.js.aucun capteur choisi : la règle ne surve: no sensor chosen: the rule watches nothing

plugins/alertebe/plugin_info/configurati.Le plugin n'a pas de réglage global : ch: The plugin has no global setting: each watch has its rules, actions and reminders on its own page. No daemon, no dependency: a listener reacts to every new sensor value, and the Jeedom cron runs every minute for confirmation delays, reminders and silent sensors.
